text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Right. Not a single speck of dust on the 
frills or the jacket. Are there any loose 
threads on the back, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, who had been taking care of 
her racewear, turned around with a twirl. 
When I told her there were no issues—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! Then all that's left... is 
this little star, right?
choice_data_list: Accessories for your chest or tail, huh.
Accessories for your chest or tail, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's gotten quite a few more 
scratches. And the color's faded, too...
choice_data_list: Should we order a new one from the URA?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, actually, the accessory part is 
handmade by me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So, I'll polish it myself!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've even prepared a specialized polishing 
cloth! I'll make it sparkle... absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Scrub, scrub*... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that looks a bit better now. Now for 
this scratch here...
choice_data_list: Want to switch out if you're tired?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern! Don't worry, 
I'm still totally full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she's been working for two hours 
straight now. I wonder if she's alright.
choice_data_list:
Maybe you should at least take a short 
break...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's true... But just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because it's an accessory I made, filled 
with so much love and care.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to polish it until it sparkles.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Polishing it like this really 
brings back memories~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
See, I even whittled the pointy parts of 
this star myself. That part was really 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I didn't want to compromise. ...In 
order to give form to my feelings.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because this proof of having run 
alongside my racewear is sure to leave a 
mark on someone's heart."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even if it gets hurt, even if it gets 
dirty... I absolutely want to make it 
shine with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just kidding! Maybe I'm being a bit 
too particular about it, though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is one thing I cannot give up 
on. Now then, just one more push!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...!? Ehehe, then I'll gladly 
take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Lastly, attach it with some glue, and—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It's doooone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look. With this, the jewel's sparkle will 
reach even those far away.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like a real star... I hope it reaches 
a lot of people.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Reaching us from far across the 
distance... Such an endless radiance."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking... that I want to 
become an Umamusume like that too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach someone's heart too— 
together with this accessory.
choice_data_list: Let's share your brilliance with everyone!
Let's share your brilliance with everyone!

I'm sure everyone will admire that racing 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach someone's heart too— 
together with this accessory.
choice_data_list: Let's share your brilliance with everyone!
Let's share your brilliance with everyone!

I'm sure everyone will admire that racing 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. In that case, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Now that your racewear is sparkling 
clean, shall we head straight into 
training?"
choice_data_list:
Huh, even after maintaining it so 
thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Something like this is no problem. More 
importantly—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
My body is practically itching to move. I 
want to just sprint out of here right this 
second.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, thank you very much. Well then, 
let's get going, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'll show you a run that won't be 
outshone by this radiance.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "And then, someone received my feelings—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I hope those feelings carry on to someone 
else.
